notes.title: Town to City Hotfixes
notes.content:
[b][h3]Good day, everyone! [/h3][/b]

We are excited to bring you the latest patch!

[b]Version 7619[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed that not all decorations would appear in one of the filter categories. 
[*] Fixed that the road brushing menu disappears when pressing ESC while brushing crops at a farm. 
[*] Updated the dark brown road indicating a road is too thin to only appear on even thinner roads. 
[*] Fixed that the plaza road and upgraded road would not turn dark brown indicating too thin road. 
[*] Updated Vineyard Visions inhabitant request to only ask for 100 grapes instead of 150. 
[*] Fixed that the green road highlight indicating building range would not update if you drew additional roads while the highlight was visible. 
[*] Fixed farming mechanics and granary would become disabled after reloading a Sandbox mode save in specifically the Belvau map. 
[*] Fixed some small animation errors in the various activities people can perform while at buildings. 
[*] Fixed that request dialogues were unreasonably heavy on performance. 
[*] Fixed that you could be connected to Twitch twice if you double clicked the authorize button. 
[*] Fixed that sometimes building connections would be lost after erasing a piece of road and then replacing it again. 
[*] Fixed that removing decorations that were blocking a connection doesn't always bring back that building connection. 
[/list]
We cannot thank you enough for all of your feedback and bug reports so far! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3115220/Town_to_City/

notes.title: Town to City Hotfixes
notes.content:
[h3][b]Greetings, citizens![/b]

We would like to thank you for all your feedback and bug reports so far, and we bring you the first lot of hotfixes for Town to City! [/h3]

[b]Version 7546[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where loading the game from an autosave, progressing and then switching maps would cause loss of progress. 
[*] Fixed an issue where autosaves named AUTOSAVE10 or AUTOSAVE11 would not load properly. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the game would softlock with a black screen when upgrading the mayor’s home or the city hall while on low frame rates. 
[*] Added the following updates to the Twitch Integration feature:
[/list] - Greatly reduced the occurrence of inhabitants nametags overlapping when they are in the same building. 
- Fixed an issue where nametags were not clickable. 
- Nametags will now fade out and scale down with distance. 
- Added text wrapping to Twitch chat messages appearing in the game. 

All of your bug reports and feedback are incredibly helpful to us during the Early Access period, and we appreciate all of them!

notes.title: Town to City Demo Update!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Greetings, Citizens!

Still on the fence about buying the game? We’re thrilled to bring you a brand new update to our demo![/b]

We have heard your feedback, and we’re happy to let you know that new towns created within this demo update will transfer over to the full game. [/h3]

Please note that starting up this new demo will mean that you will be starting completely fresh, as saves will not transfer over from the old demo. If you would like to continue on your old save on the older version of the demo, then you will be able to do so by doing the following:

[list]
[*] Right click on the Town to City demo and click ‘Properties’. 
[*] Go to ‘Betas’ and click on the drop down menu to choose which demo version you would like to play. 
[/list]

The new demo is more reflective of the final game, and we hope that you enjoy it! 

[h3][u][b]Additional Patch Notes[/b][/u][/h3]

[list]
[*] Added a shortcut to temporarily swap to eraser while doing road brushing.
[*] Added an option to not draw over existing roads while doing road brushing.
[*] Added camera edge scrolling (and an option to turn it off). 
[*] Added an option to swap the middle mouse button and right mouse button (for camera controls). 
[*] Can now place decorations on the ground closer to houses. 
[*] Removed commute happiness and replaced it with a city density based happiness.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3115220/Town_to_City/

notes.title: Dev Diary V - What We’ve Been Working On!
notes.content:
[h3][b] Greetings, Citizens![/b][/h3][p]
[b]We’ve been hard at work on Town to City, so we thought we would showcase a little bit of what we’ve been working on recently. [/b]

[/p][h3][u][b]TWITCH INTERGRATION[/b][/u][/h3][p]
We’ve been having a lot of fun working on Twitch integration for Town to City! With this new feature, if a Twitch streamer plays Town to City, viewers who send a message will have a citizen assigned to them and be able to see their message. Twitch Streamer MimiChair tried this out for the first time on her stream, and people loved to see themselves walking in the town!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45467811/2b81a3476bea71ee3b8b559423aa53befbf05341.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][u][b]NAMES IN WORLD[/b][/u][/h3][p]
If you rename a citizen in your town, their name will show above that citizen! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45467811/5f5c63a4c58e6812e13bfb3b3b644e891836cdb9.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45467811/f0ed45d8221e3b24555a76e1ad0cc038373c3d22.png"][/img][/p][h3][u][b]ANIMATRONIC FLOWER MONUMENT[/b][/u][/h3][p]
Animator Milou made this animatronic flower monument! Twice a day, it will open for a small show, then close again. Artist Alejandra took these beautiful shots of it! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45467811/47f00b41a212c0707d4dac6089ec26bd61b54e87.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45467811/6e32af328853867421ba551cf3fbf591c2b5a30c.png"][/img]The monuments in Town to City are special items that can be unlocked in the tech tree by having enough citizens and a high happiness level. Each monument can only be placed once within the city!

[/p][h3][u][b]APOTHECARY BUILDING[/b][/u][/h3][p]
An apothecary building fit for a growing town! Made by Galaxy Grove artist Jan, this apothecary building is the perfect place for your citizens to pick up their remedies.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45467811/71bf514a80a0570d9959338bd86749464a44ecc4.png"][/img][/p][h3][u][b]LUTHIER BUILDING[/b][/u][/h3][p]
Take a look at the luthier building created by Milou! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45467811/bf75d371947053e71e3582345834a57e93e8ec05.png"][/img][/p][h3][u][b]GRANARY BUILDING[/b][/u][/h3][p]
The Granary serves a similar purpose as the Warehouse, but for farms. The Granary also distributes produce to certain shops that need fresh produce!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45467811/63956f00935b12e0e6abd91b35f229877278f4e0.png"][/img][/p][h3][u][b]POST OFFICE BUILDING[/b][/u][/h3][p]
Milou also created this stunning Post Office!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45467811/64f1a2ba16e1b8838d9d7ab3138bba17085d3514.png"][/img][/p][h3][u][b]PATHS[/b][/u][/h3][p]
As requested by a lot of demo players, we have been working on the ability to choose whether a newly drawn road replaces already existing roads or not! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45467811/ee80da9f4b859a880f2391b118bbdf9fdd8a99e3.png"][/img]
And those are just some of the many aspects we’ve been working on for the release! We have really appreciated everyone’s feedback on the demo, and we’re so excited for everyone to see what else we have in store for Town to City. 

[b]Wishlist Town to City now! [/b]

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3115220/Town_to_City/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Add Town to City to your wishlist now, and keep up to date with all things Galaxy Grove in the Discord![/b][/h3][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45467811/80b33daded427cce0d420e0ee0f51d68eb115bb5.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250025/bb7e23a1085b28d25df050902e1e02b960917525.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250025/53a9f2fcd1bf24f4e1735dbc90b248bd39572da1.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250025/1e551f92a20d174c14f449ebd6ef769c2f8de0af.png"][/img][/p]

[h3][b]Greetings, Everyone![/b]
[/h3][h3] We bring a small hotfix for our new demo![/h3][p]
[b]Version 5960
[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved localization for all languages[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed that certain photomode features did not work properly after opening it for the first time.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some text wrapping issues under certain languages[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed that a resident's commute happiness did not update properly
[/p][/*][/list][p]We are currently investigating the Fatal Error crashes that some people are experiencing, and it is looking as though they may be related to driver issues with Nvideo videocards. [/p][p][/p][p]We recommend updating your drivers to the latest version, but failing this, try rolling back to the drivers from December 2024. You can also try running on Medium graphics quality instead of High, as this disables some of Unreal Engine’s more advanced features which may give problems with certain drivers.[/p][p][/p][p]If you have tried any of these options, then it would be incredibly helpful if you could leave a comment with what you did and whether this solved the issue. In the meantime, we are continuing to look into these crashes and provide a more permanent solution. We would like to thank everyone who has played our demo and left feedback so far, we are so grateful!
